SUV Accident Causes Significant Traffic Jam on Delhi-Gurugram Expressway

A speeding SUV collided with a car near Jharsa Chowk on the Delhi-Gurugram Expressway, leading to a substantial traffic disruption. The incident resulted in a 4-kilometer long traffic jam, affecting commuters on the busy expressway. The damaged car came to a halt in the middle of the road, which contributed to the traffic congestion.
